title: Initialize Cargo project with module structure
user_story: As a developer, I need the Cargo project initialized with the correct directory layout so all subsequent work has a place to land.
description: Create the Cargo.toml with all required dependencies and set up the module structure from CLAUDE.md. This is the very first code issue — everything else depends on it. The binary should compile and print a placeholder message.

acceptance_criteria.then: a `hookbin` binary is produced with zero errors and zero warnings
clap shows a help message with the `serve` subcommand

all modules from CLAUDE.md exist as files (even if stubbed): main.rs, server.rs, db.rs, models.rs, error.rs, config.rs, retention.rs, rate_limit.rs, handlers/{ingest,hooks,requests,dashboard,health}.rs

functions.name: main
functions.signature: #[tokio::main] async fn main() -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>>
functions.description: Entry point: parse CLI args with clap, then delegate to serve

single_binary_checklist.notes: This issue establishes the single-binary structure. rusqlite must use 'bundled' feature to compile SQLite into the binary.
